member.name: T:ObviousPDF.Csv.PdfCsvRenderer
member.summary: Renders a PDF from a CSV document conforming to the ObviousPDF CSV Format. Implements the full processing pipeline defined in the CSV requirements.
member.remarks: Internally, the CSV is deserialized into the shared document model and then processed by the same rendering pipeline as the JSON renderer, ensuring identical behavior across all three input formats.

member.name: P:ObviousPDF.Csv.PdfCsvRendererOptions.GenerateAccessibilityReport
member.summary:
When set to true, an internal accessibility report is generated after building the PDF document. The report is available via when using or via when using .
Disclaimer: This automated report is provided solely to assist in the assessment of document accessibility. It is not a comprehensive accessibility audit. To confirm that WCAG or PDF/UA standards are fully met, human assessment by an accessibility specialist is recommended.
